_note: Food photos, one entry per picture, for Facebook posts and later the site. Images live in src/assets/photos/ as web copies: about 2000px, upright, camera and GPS data stripped. Full-size originals go in photos-originals/ at the repo root, which git ignores; never commit a camera original, because phone photos carry the GPS location. `file` is the path under /assets/. `item` is the dish EXACTLY as named in menu.json, so a post can pull the price and description from the menu instead of retyping them. `variant` is set when the photo shows one version of a two-way item. The hot sandwiches are listed as 'X Burger or Chicken', so a chicken photo has variant 'Chicken' and a beef one 'Burger'; otherwise null. `title` is what the post calls the dish. `alt` describes the picture for screen readers. `date` is when it was taken (YYYY-MM-DD). Use only photos the cafe took or has permission to use.
